paper.title: Intentional Action and Side-Effects in Ordinary Language
paper.description: Does a harmful side effect seem more intentional than a helpful one, even when the decision maker says they care only about another goal?

review.reason: Accepted exact candidate as a concise reading-only research summary with source locators and explicit scope limits. This is not full-instrument or executable-protocol approval.
checks: Checked both randomly assigned park vignettes: N=78 and 42, harmful/helpful intentionality percentages and printed chi-square statistics.
Checked responsibility-rating interpretation and revised section locators; pooled analysis is distinct from the two experiments and does not assert causal mediation.

review.reviewScope: Primary-source comparison of the claims actually present in this concise reading summary, citation section/table locators, and public-asset privacy. Not exhaustive extraction, reanalysis, runtime testing, or historical-fidelity certification.
